static_traits.name: 周文泽
static_traits.social_status: Limited social interaction, difficult to connect with others; has one friend to confide in
static_traits.medical_history: No similar psychological problems before; has not received psychotherapy; no major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, acceptable logicality, neutral tone; obvious self-criticism tendency, fairly good cooperation but a cautiously skeptical attitude toward change

basic_info.main_problem: 我常觉得自己not负责任、have not生产力，尤其在工作之外的生活领域；这种感觉自一年前因生病上班迟到后开始，并逐渐发展为在日常生活中持续感到overwhelmed与低效。
basic_info.core_demands: 寻求咨询是因为这些not够胜任与低效的感觉开始影响我的心理健康和日常功能。
growth_experiences: 大约一年前因生病导致上班迟到，这一具体事件trigger了强烈的内疚与“我not负责任”的自我标签；此后开始对自己设定僵化的规则（如必须始终准时、必须按计划完美执行），在not yet能完成计划或意识到“浪费时间”时加重自我批评；同时频繁将自己与“生活井然有序”的他人比较，逐步在饮食、自我照料和社交方面陷入低效与overwhelmed。

core_beliefs: I am not good enough / not capable enough

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: without论任何情况我都必须准时，否则就说明我not负责任/失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: To avoid making mistakes again, setting stricter, more rigid time rules and schedules for oneself, and severely blaming oneself when deviating

special_situations.event: not yet能按既定日程完成打扫与做饭的计划（因疲惫改为点外卖）
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能完美遵守计划，就证明I am a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Makes stricter plans and goals, forces oneself to carry them out

special_situations.event: When comparing oneself with others看到do not人更有条理、产出更高
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not如他人高效，就说明I am not good enough、not配合群
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 加倍要求自己、设定更高目标；Reduced socializing互动
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not as good as others，I am not good enough

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 时间not应被浪费；一旦有浪费就意味着我整体not负责任
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reinforcement时间管理与自我监督，努力纠正“失误”

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be seen as capable and responsible, maintaining a recognized sense of self-worth
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被评判为懒惰或失败者、被他人negate与疏离
defense_goal: Controls mistakes through harsh self-rules and self-criticism, avoids being blamed and humiliated

object_relations.self_representation: not够好的、需要not断证明自己的个体
object_relations.object_representation: Others are critical judges / more organized people

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor suggests relaxing the rule of 'must execute the plan perfectly' and advocates self-care
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将灵活性理解为“变得更not负责任”，担心因此被视为失败
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以平静但坚持的语气提出担忧，例如“如果not严格，我会更not高效”，用理性论证而回避情绪层面的体验。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当谈到过去的失误（如迟到、not yet完成计划）时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将具体情境的偶发失误等同于对自身品格的全面negate
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 自我贬低、use负性标签（如“我就是失败者”），语气低落，Reinforcement内疚感。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When deeply exploring his emotional experiences such as guilt and shame
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为直接触及情绪是危险或without益，选择仅陈述事实以保持掌控
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use冷静、中性语气描述事件与计划，避免use情绪词汇与停留在情绪层面。

manifestations: Limited social interaction; hard to connect with others
outcomes: Daily functioning affected (inefficient eating and self-care)

manifestations: Constrains himself with rigid 'must / should' rules
担心若更灵活会更not高效
outcomes: Restricted life flexibility, decreased tolerance for experience

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 频繁use“必须/应该”的自我要求（如必须始终准时、必须完美遵循计划）
Takes external productivity standards as the sole basis for self-evaluation

contact_model.definition: The individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: 计划失败后将not满与挫败Turning against the self的严厉自责与贬低
用“I am a failure”之类的负性标签攻击自己而非寻求支持

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 频繁比较自己与他人、过度反省not足
Worries that relaxing standards will lead to losing control, thus maintaining high self-restriction

positive_force: 工作表现Good（能稳定完成职责）
Has a certain foundation of self-discipline and time management (makes plans and goals)
Willing to proactively seek help and try cognitive restructuring (proactively came for counseling)
Having a trustworthy friend to confide in
negative_force: Rigid 'must / should' rules and perfectionist tendencies
过度比较他人与自我，易Self-denial
Weak social support、Living alone带来的Loneliness感
Overgeneralization of a single mistake and persistent guilt

target_behavior.behavior: Self-reproach and negative self-labels（如“我not负责任”“I am a failure”）
antecedent: not yet能按既定日程执行（如打扫与做饭计划）
target_behavior.core_reason: Introjection的僵化规范与完美主义，将一次失误泛化为整体not合格以维持控制与避免被评判
target_behavior.function: 逃避not完美带来的Anxiety与羞耻，试图通过自我惩罚维持“负责任”的自我形象
target_behavior.consequence: Increased stress、Decreased efficiency，进一步影响饮食、社交与自我照料

target_behavior.behavior: Rigid time and task rules (must follow the plan perfectly)
antecedent: Creating and starting to follow a detailed schedule
When physical fatigue appears or situations change and arrangements need adjusting
Any deviation or delay from the plan
target_behavior.core_reason: 将“准时/完美执行”与自我价值直接挂钩，担心灵活性会导致失控与not负责任
target_behavior.function: 获得控制感与安全感，避免被他人或自己评判为“not负责”
target_behavior.consequence: Reduced flexibility, intensified frustration and guilt further hinder actual completion

antecedent: Facing social invitations or scenes requiring connection with people
target_behavior.core_reason: Low sense of self-worth、担心被评判为not够高效或not合群
target_behavior.function: 逃避被比较与负面评价的可能性，短期缓解Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Loneliness感增加，Reduced social support，进一步削弱情绪与功能恢复

target_behavior.behavior: Inefficient eating and self-care (such as switching to ordering takeout after a planned meal fails)
target_behavior.core_reason: Under rigid rules, highly sensitive to failure, emotional frustration appears and action motivation decreases
target_behavior.function: Short-term avoidance of complex tasks and feelings of failure
target_behavior.consequence: 自我照料质量下降，维持低效循环，加重overwhelmed体验
